name: Yuria Chrono-schnee weizen
original_name: ユリア=クロノシュネーヴァイシェン
source:
The Third Seat of the "Seventh Chord". Yuria is known as the "elder sister figure" from [url=https://vndb.org/c18802]Mikoto[/url], due to her honorable and cool personality. A very charismatic individual since her youth, her superiority is even acknowledged by [url=https://vndb.org/c20673]Faust[/url] as a hero. She was taken in by the organization when she was seriously injured after falling down, and was brought up as a combat specialist. After the incident, she lost her childhood memories and her family origin, and has been actively looking for them on her own. 

Proudful of her combat style as a sniper, Yuria is able to snipe at extremely long distances in a magic warfare. She always captures her targets and prevents them in escaping due to her excellent precision and advanced tactics. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=853984]Getchu[/url]]

[spoiler]She is actually [url=/c21321]Kengo's[/url] older sister.[/spoiler]
